chapter: With Chick Webb and Ella Fitzgerald, 1936-39
title: "A-Tisket, A-Tasket" makes Ella a feature attraction
summary: Ella was built into a featured act, and "A-Tisket, A-Tasket" gave her a hit.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: double attraction. That was the beginning of (inaudible) her -- when we put all that music behind her, all those big pop songs, all those big hits.
Then we went to Boston. She went with that "Tisket A Tasket" of hers. That really did it for her, you know.
And that became like a double attraction. See, but all this stuff had to happen before she got into "Tisket A Tasket."
We had made her a part of the band. Instead of just being a vocal with the band, we had started featuring her with the band.
Just like, when she came on, she did more than one song. She did like two or three songs. She was like a feature attraction with the band.
She'd come out and sing like two or three numbers. Then when she came back, we did Tisket A Tasket. That put the creme -- you know, the icing on the cake for her.
Then she became like a feature attraction with this Tisket A Tasket where we played. When we went back on the road, Everybody was (inaudible), everybody would bring their
